title: eFinancials AML (Anti-Money Laundering)
description: Anti-money laundering rules and batch detection pipeline for banking and finance clients.
details: Anti-money laundering module of the eFinancials system that consolidates transactions from the Savings, Fixed Deposit, Leasing, and Pawning modules and runs detection rules against them to flag suspicious activity for banking and finance clients.
longDescription:
June 2025 – Present

• Created AML business rules that detect suspicious transactions for banking and finance clients
• Maintained the AML batch pipeline that consolidates transactions from the Savings, Fixed Deposit, Leasing, and Pawning modules through T-SQL stored procedures and runs detection rules against them using SQL Server Agent jobs
• Diagnosed alert-timing defects in rule lookback windows, fixed logic errors in detection rules, and rewrote the underlying queries for better performance
• Debugged and stabilized the ASP.NET Core AML backend APIs, resolving routing conflicts, route template bugs, and build failures after a source control migration
• Handled live client issues and prepared deliverables for deployments across environments

title: eFinancials Workflow Management
description: Shared microfrontend for configurable, multi-level approval workflows.
details: Shared workflow microfrontend reused across modules of the eFinancials system, enabling modules to run dynamic, configurable workflows with multi-level approvals for their business processes.
longDescription:
June 2025 – Present

• Configured and maintained a shared microfrontend reused across modules in the eFinancials system, enabling additional modules to run workflows for their business processes
• Created and modified 5+ RESTful APIs and 5+ reusable Angular components to support dynamic, configurable workflow processes
• Implemented user access handling for multi-level approval workflows and owned the build and maintenance of the module's frontend components

title: eFinancials Central
description: Business partner onboarding and KYC customer management module.
details: Core business module of the eFinancials system that streamlines business partner onboarding, with secure KYC management of customer personal information, contact data, and risk profiling, plus role management and audit trails.
longDescription:
June 2025 – Dec 2025

• Developed a core business module of the eFinancials system to streamline the business partner onboarding process, enabling secure management of customer details (KYC) including personal information, contact data, and risk profiling
• Delivered key functionality covering user role management, audit trails, category updates, and customer inquiry and maintenance operations
• Responsible for building scalable frontend components, integrating backend APIs, and ensuring data accuracy and security across modules
